diagnostics.message:
Lean rejected `Uorc.Uorc.Integrity.StateLaws` (error): Type mismatch
  advance_some_count_branches chain buffer count block phase
    (Sha256.valid { chain := chain, buffer := buffer, count := count, work := some block, phase := phase })
    (block.round.beq 64)
has type
  countPreserved { chain := chain, buffer := buffer, count := count, work := some block, phase := phase }
    (if
        Sha256.valid { chain := chain, buffer := buffer, count := count, work := some block, phase := phase } =
          true then
      match { chain := chain, buffer := buffer, count := count, work := some block, phase := phase }.work with
      | none => Except.error Sha256.Error.invalidState
      | some compression =>
        Except.ok
          (if block.round.beq 64 = true then
            { chain := Sha256.feedForward compression,
              buffer := { chain := chain, buffer := buffer, count := count, work := some block, phase := phase }.buffer,
              count := { chain := chain, buffer := buffer, count := count, work := some block, phase := phase }.count,
              work := none,
              phase := { chain := chain, buffer := buffer, count := count, work := some block, phase := phase }.phase }
          else
            { chain := { chain := chain, buffer := buffer, count := count, work := some block, phase := phase }.chain,
              buffer := { chain := chain, buffer := buffer, count := count, work := some block, phase := phase }.buffer,
              count := { chain := chain, buffer := buffer, count := count, work := some block, phase := phase }.count,
              work := some (Sha256.compressionRound compression),
              phase := { chain := chain, buffer := buffer, count := count, work := some block, phase := phase }.phase })
    else Except.error Sha256.Error.invalidState)
but is expected to have type
  countPreserved { chain := chain, buffer := buffer, count := count, work := some block, phase := phase }
    (Sha256.advanceWork { chain := chain, buffer := buffer, count := count, work := some block, phase := phase })
